query:
SELECT tt.id, tt.appUserId, tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.description, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt, au.name, au.email
FROM token_transactions tt
JOIN app_users au ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE tt.createdAt >= '2026-03-17'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
